hook: Fire in Khairatabad GHMC zonal office burns *cheque section* papers
hook_b: Fire in Khairatabad GHMC zonal office burns *cheque section* papers
tldr: A fire broke out on Friday morning on the second floor of the GHMC Zonal Office in Khairatabad, reportedly reducing several documents in the cheque section to ashes.

beats.what: A fire broke out on the second floor of the GHMC Zonal Office in Khairatabad on Friday morning.
beats.why: Several important documents stored in the cheque section were reportedly reduced to ashes.
beats.care: Fire personnel brought the blaze under control before it reached other parts of the building.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Officials have not yet said what caused the fire or how many records were lost.

cards.q: After this fire, what matters most for civic records?

qs: Were the burnt cheque-section records backed up digitally?
Will services at the Khairatabad zonal office be affected?

facts.t: Siasat reports the fire was in the office's *records room*.

steps.e: Fire crews contain it to the room
Cause and damage not yet known

viz.verdict: No word yet on which records were lost.

watch: Officials are yet to ascertain the cause and the extent of the damage.
